note: Touchpoint inventory for the-usual recipe (ported from skill-the-usual 86377ed). Matching rule: whitespace is normalized and markdown bold (**) is stripped before comparison; wording and punctuation must remain verbatim. kind is one of HARD STOP, PROHIBITION, QUESTION. This recipe has no mid-run QUESTION kind by design: halts surface to the parent via the *-halt-guard steps. step is the recipe step id that canonically owns the touchpoint.

entries.quote: Do NOT start implementation on main/master.
Never load any other skill; in particular never load `code-review`.
Preserve unrelated changes from other agents in the same repo — never clobber work you did not author.
Ask for clarification rather than guessing.
Don't force through blockers - stop and ask.
It is always OK to stop and say "this is too hard for me."
STOP and report it rather than guessing.
If the command errors, run the gate (fail closed).
Repeat the inventory-remediation-rerun cycle until the suite is green excluding ledger-recorded pre-existing failures.
a candidate path whose failure mode is data loss/corruption that cannot be planned around is a halt, never `acceptable`.
NEVER reduce test coverage or skip/disable tests to make things pass.
"Suggested next steps" must NOT recommend merging
